tiers.name: Standard Rectangular Padded Batching ([64, 8192] = 524,288 Padded Tokens)
tiers.note: 1 long 8,192-token chunk forces all 63 short 256-token chunks to pad to 8,192 (95.4% waste, 30x attention FLOP inflation -> 1,420ms)!

tiers.name: Length-Sorted Micro-Bucketing (4 Sub-Batches, Still Padded Within Buckets)
tiers.note: Reduces padding to 34.0%, but launches 4 serial forward passes per batch (4x weight HBM reads -> 385.0ms).

tiers.name: 1D Ragged Varlen Packing (cu_seqlens) + Default Unused 45GB KV Cache Allocation
tiers.note: Eliminates 100% of padding (24,320 real tokens in 1 pass = 145ms), but leaving default KV cache enabled wastes 45GB HBM and caps max_num_batched_tokens.

tiers.name: 1D Varlen (cu_seqlens) + Token-Budget Batching + Zero-KV Pool (or Shared-Query Prefix Rerank)
tiers.note: 0.0% padding via flash_attn_varlen_func + reclaims 45GB HBM for 64K token-budget batching + shared-query prefix caching on 1x100 reranking -> 112ms (12.7x faster)!
